Currently
column2: we can panic the box if the first block group we go to move is of a

column1: type where there is no space left to move those extents.  For example
fill the disk up with data
column2: and then we try to balance and we have no room to

column1: move the data nor room to allocate new chunks
column2: we will panic.  Change this by

column1: checking to see if we have room to move this chunk around
-ENOSPC and move on to the next chunk.  This will make sure we remove block
groups that are moveable
column2: like if we have alot of empty metadata block groups

column1: and then that way we make room to be able to balance our data chunks as well.
Tested this with an fs that would panic on btrfs-vol -b normally
panics with this patch.
-actually search for a free extent on the device to make sure we can allocate a
chunk if need be.
-fix btrfs_shrink_device to make sure we actually try to relocate all the
chunks
column2: and then if we can't return -ENOSPC so if we are doing a btrfs-vol -r

column1: we don't remove the device with data still on it.
-check to make sure the block group we are going to relocate isn't the last one
in that particular space
-fix a bug in btrfs_shrink_device where we would change the device's size and
not fix it if we fail to do our relocate
